messages:
Nate: Quick flag - backup encoder tripped on Stage 2 during the product demo. Fallback to cloud encoder in 45s. Heads-up that stream might hiccup and recording will be split.
Priya: Copy. I'm pausing live caption ingestion while we flip to avoid dupes.
Jordan: Can we keep the demo running or pause for resync? Hosts are asking.
Nate: We'd prefer to keep demo going, switch is seamless for viewers but there will be a 3-5s gap in the iso files.
Cam: If we keep going, we'll need to move Olivia's leadership Q&A to immediately after demo so she isn't midstream during the flip. Any objections? @Olivia (CEO)
Olivia (CEO): Fine with moving the Q&A later. Please announce to attendees so they don't post questions early.
Priya: Announcement posted in the room and overlay banner updated: "Q&A moved to post-demo".
Jordan: Cloud encoder now live. Command used:
```
# cloud-encode switch
encoderctl activate cloud-stage2
```
Jordan: Stream looks stable on my end. Viewer-side continuity checks pass.
stream-bot: [automated] Stream health: viewers=1.2k, dropped_frames=0.2%, latency=2.1s.
ops-bot: [automated] Recorder split created: /recordings/stage2/part_A.mp4 and /recordings/stage2/part_B.mp4
Nate: Thanks. Cam, please ask hosts to hold questions until Olivia's cue and to call the first two audience mics in order to keep flow.
Cam: Will do. Also toggled "hold questions" on Slido.
Priya: Caption stream resumed, low-latency ON. We'll re-sync final captions with the iso audio if needed in post.
Jordan: Leaving a note for post-team: merge parts A/B and run a quick audio-level pass to smooth the cut. I can auto-normalize if needed.
Olivia (CEO): Appreciate the quick handling. After the demo, I'll take two audience questions and one pre-submitted question about roadmap timelines.
Nate: Perfect. I'll add a 30s runway between demo end and Olivia's cue to let systems stabilize.
Cam: Hosts briefed. Recording links and edit notes will be posted after wrap.
Priya: I'll drop a short postmortem in #all-hands with timestamps for any editors.
Nate: Great work team. Back to the show :clap:
